metadata.description: Software Factory: a Claude Code plugin that runs work through a multi-agent assembly line

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Software Factory: a multi-agent line with isolated builds, independent proof, three reviewers and a human merge gate

plugins.name: factory-plugin-builder
plugins.description: Builds software-factory plugins: scaffolds one from the template, checks plugins against the CLI convention with a fix per finding, and runs a plugin's full verification gate

plugins.name: factory-dev
plugins.description: Dev tooling for developing software-factory: one check command that runs every CI gate, and the release tag/version check that prints the release notes for a version

plugins.name: factory-docs
plugins.description: Keeps software-factory docs in sync with code: a map from each doc to the code it describes, which docs cover a file, which docs a change left stale, a lint for the map and CLI command coverage, and the gate CI runs

plugins.name: factory-plugin-advisor
plugins.description: Tracks recurring friction with the software-factory plugins (CLI failures, workarounds, manual steps, missing guidance, user corrections) in a local redacted log, and drafts a suggested plugin change with a paste-ready /factory:run request once an issue recurs

plugins.name: factory-plugin-discover
plugins.description: Finds the installed plugin or skill that fits a software-factory task, offers to install a fitting software-factory marketplace plugin that is not installed yet, and points at factory-plugin-advisor when nothing fits: a local, deterministic catalog and matcher, a mode setting and a guarded install, plus a prompt hook that hints at it.

plugins.name: factory-doctor
plugins.description: Tracks and checks what an app needs to run, per profile (dev, stage, test): env vars by name, tools and versions, files, services, Claude plugins and skills, in a committed .factory/doctor.json; checks this machine against a profile and scans the repo to propose missing requirements. Never stores or prints a value.

plugins.name: factory-signing
plugins.description: Makes every git commit Claude makes signed with your own SSH key through your ssh-agent: diagnoses what is missing, sets git up only when you confirm, prints your allowed-signers line, and a hook that stops unsigned commits in repos that require signing
